💡 This work introduces insoluble BA–NPE nanoaggregates as a molecularly aligned electrolyte for aqueous zinc-ion batteries, forming hydrophobic interfacial layers that suppress water attack and dendrites. It enables 4500 h Zn//Zn cycling and a 1.3 Ah pouch cell with 81.8% retention over 900 cycles, demonstrating a practical strategy for stable Ah-level AZIBs.

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work reveals how the number and position of trifluoromethyl groups in DEC-based solvents govern Li+ solvation structure. Symmetric dual-substitution enriches anion/FEC solvation, forming robust interphases. This enables Ni-rich NCM811 cathodes (10.5 mg cm⁻²) to retain 80% capacity after 300 cycles at 4.6 V, offering rational design principles for fluorinated high-voltage electrolytes.

item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work uniquely reconstructs wood-chip biomass into a cellulose-lignin hydrogel electrolyte mimicking plant fiber-bark architecture. Its novelty lies in triple Zn²⁺ confinement via phosphate chelators, Schiff-base coordination, and polymeric domains, enabling 600-hour flexible zinc-air battery cycling. It shifts the durability paradigm from water retention to hierarchical ion regulation, offering a sustainable, biodegradable energy storage solution.

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces proton-mediated coordination equilibrium as a new mechanism enabling nonfreezing Zn2+ transport in hydrogel electrolytes. By balancing phytic acid and zinc phytate, it suppresses water crystallization and sustains hopping ion transport, achieving 2.4 mS cm−1 at −60°C and stable cycling. This offers a general design principle for ultralow-temperature aqueous batteries.
🏷 zinc battery · hydrogel electrolyte · proton coordination · low-temperature transport · nonfreezing

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study provides the first experimental evidence that hetero-grain boundaries (h-GBs) in inorganic Li/electrolyte interphases enable favorable Li-ion transport. Using an MgO/MgF₂ heterostructure, it shows h-GB-rich Li₂O/LiF interphases plus Li–Mg alloy formation synergistically stabilize Li metal anodes, offering a design blueprint for high-stability Li-metal batteries.
